authoring_basis: Only source/labels.json label and slot contract. No training data, predictions, public dataset rows, or other writer outputs were read.
grouping: Near paraphrases and relevant negative contrasts share groups across labels. Repeated panel-setting constructions share one group across all three settings. Groups are intentionally broader than tags describing sentence construction.
slot_annotation_notes: Non-action, clarification, reasoning, compound, and out-of-scope rows use empty slots because the contract supplies no per-label slot schema for these labels.

Bubble fields use value for literal text/boolean, mm-suffixed relative or dimension fields for bbox, locator for speaker/owner, and 1-based bubble_number for join target; those payload key spellings are annotations, not runtime schema claims.
Text-frame alignment uses the contract default reference selection_bounds; no absolute placement is invented.
Named characters preserve literal honorifics; existence and uniqueness remain execution-side checks.
limitations: Synthetic evaluation only; not evidence of real voice or real-user accuracy.
The eight planned public rows are not included here; this component intentionally has four not_command and four out_of_scope_request rows.
Cross-dataset family overlap has not been checked because this authoring task forbids reading training data or other authors outputs.
No classifier training, inference, service invocation, or UI execution occurred.
